event_name: One Drop Brewing Co. 20 Tap Takeover!
date_text: Thu, Nov 5th • 12:00 PM AEDT - Sun, Nov 8th • 10:00 PM AEDT
description: 20 Beers. One Brewery. One Massive Tap Takeover! We’re handing over the taps to Sydney’s very own One Drop Brewing Co. for an epic showcase of some of the most creative, flavour-packed beers in the country! Known for pushing boundaries, experimenting with flavours and producing some seriously outrageous sours, One Drop is bringing an incredible lineup of 20 beers to Hotel Sweeney’s. Expect everything from juicy hazy pales and hop-loaded IPAs to big, bold double IPAs and a massive selection of their signature fruited sours. Get in early, because once they’re gone, they’re gone!
